items.source:
Find all keys matching the given pattern.
It is recommended to use ReactiveKeyCommands.scan(ScanOptions) to iterate over the keyspace as ReactiveKeyCommands.keys(Publisher) is a non-interruptible and expensive Redis operation.
items.translation:
查找所有匹配给定模式的键。
建议使用 ReactiveKeyCommands.scan(ScanOptions) 来遍历键空间，因为 ReactiveKeyCommands.keys(Publisher) 是一个不可中断且昂贵的 Redis 操作。

items.source: Get the scores of elements with ReactiveZSetCommands.ZMScoreCommand.getValues() from sorted set with key ReactiveRedisConnection.KeyCommand.getKey()
items.translation: 使用 ReactiveZSetCommands.ZMScoreCommand.getValues() 获取具有键 ReactiveRedisConnection.KeyCommand.getKey() 的有序集合中元素的分数。

items.source: Get the Point representation of positions for one or more members.
items.translation: 获取一个或多个成员的 Point 位置表示。

items.source: Get / Manipulate specific integer fields of varying bit widths and arbitrary non (necessary) aligned offset stored at a given key.
items.translation: 获取/操作给定key处存储的具有不同位宽且任意非（必要）对齐偏移量的特定整数字段。

items.source: Connection package providing low-level abstractions for interacting with the various Redis 'drivers'/libraries.
items.translation: 提供低级抽象的连接器包，用于与各种 Redis“驱动程序”/库进行交互。

items.source: Get geohash representation of the position for one or more members.
items.translation: 获取一个或多个成员的地理位置哈希表示。

items.source: Get and delete the value of one or more fields from hash at key.
items.translation: 从哈希表中指定键获取并删除一个或多个字段的值。

items.source:
Get the value of one or more fields from hash at key and optionally set expiration time or
time-to-live (TTL) for given fields.
items.translation: 从哈希表中指定键获取一个或多个字段的值，并可选择地为给定字段设置过期时间或生存时间（TTL）。

items.source: Get values for given fields from hash at key.
items.translation: 从哈希表中指定键获取给定字段的值。

items.source: Get multiple values at for keysets in batches.
items.translation: 批量获取键集对应的多个值。
